title: AI SEO Agent Case Study: +28% Organic Sessions in 16 Days
description: A real AI SEO agent case study: our own GA4 data after the agent started on 10 Oct 2026, with organic sessions up 28% and blog views from 14 to 58.
author: Yogansh Banthia

hero.alt: Illustration of an AI SEO agent lifting a website's organic search traffic

fit.for: B2B founders and marketing, sales or ops heads, in any country, who want their website to bring in buyers from Google and AI search without hiring a content team.
fit.notFit: One-off blog writing, consumer brands chasing viral traffic, or teams with no budget for a paid monthly service.
fit.results: Own analytics: +28% organic sessions, 10–25 Oct vs 24 Sep–9 Oct 2026.

faq_heading: Questions buyers ask about this AI SEO agent case study

faqs.q: What did the AI SEO agent actually do on claraai.tech?
faqs.a: From 10 Oct 2026 it researched buyer keywords, wrote and published blog posts on a daily schedule, linked them to our service pages, kept the sitemap current and asked Google to index new posts.

faqs.q: Are these numbers from a client?
faqs.a: No. They are our own Google Analytics 4 figures for claraai.tech, so we can show the real screenshots without sharing any client data.

faqs.q: Is 16 days enough to judge an SEO agent?
faqs.a: It is enough to see early movement, not the full result. SEO compounds, so we judge rankings, leads and booked calls over three months or more.

faqs.q: Does an AI SEO agent also help with ChatGPT and AI search?
faqs.a: Yes. AI assistants tend to cite pages that already rank and answer questions clearly, so the same structured, question-led posts help with both Google and AI search.

faqs.q: Do I need to write or approve every post?
faqs.a: No. We agree topics, facts and tone with you once, then the agent runs daily. You can review posts whenever you like.
